title: Scavenging rechargeable lithium cells from the roadside
summary: Big Clive shows how to pick up discarded disposable vape devices from the roadside and extract the rechargeable lithium cells inside. He explains why these devices contain the same circuitry as rechargeable ones and how to reuse the cells.
why: Used as the explanation behind the free-lithium-cell scavenging idea in threads about vapes and battery reuse.

quote.text: BigClive scavenging cells from vapes. (Basically where I got the idea from)
